headline: Bitcoin is stuck near $73,500 after hot US inflation, with traders betting on a December Fed rate hike and options traders buying protection against a drop; MSCI says at about 5pm ET today (05:00 Thursday Bangkok) whether it will drop Strategy from its indexes.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko and alternative.me at about 16:05 UTC Wed 11 Nov (23:05 Bangkok; 11:05am ET). 24h changes left blank because the pages showed conflicting figures. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 32, Fear (alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index); 29 the day before.

stories.title: Bitcoin stuck near $73,500 as traders bet on a December rate hike
stories.summary: Bitcoin has barely moved since Tuesday's hotter-than-expected US inflation report and is sitting near its 200-day average, while US stock futures bounced. Traders now see a Fed rate hike in December as very likely, and options traders are paying more for protection against a fall. Higher rates make borrowing dearer and safe bonds pay more, which tends to weigh on risky assets like crypto.
points: October consumer prices rose 0.4% against a 0.3% forecast; core prices (without food and energy) rose 0.3% against 0.2%, per Decrypt.
CME FedWatch odds of a December quarter-point hike are about 90%, per CoinDesk.
Bitcoin was around $73,500 on Wednesday, per The Block; CryptoQuant puts its 200-day average near $73,200, per CoinDesk.
On the options platform Derive, the odds of bitcoin below $70,000 at Christmas rose to 31% from 15% a week ago; above $80,000 fell to 26% from 53%, per The Block.
About $725M of crypto bets were forcibly closed in 24 hours, per CoinGlass data cited by CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk: bitcoin barely flinches at hot CPI
The Block: options traders raise odds of sub-$70,000

stories.title: Bitcoin funds lose money for a fourth day in a row
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin funds had net outflows again on Tuesday, though less than half Monday's size, and they are now negative for 2026. These funds are how most US retail and adviser money reaches bitcoin, so steady outflows mean less buying support.
points: Tuesday 10 Nov: US spot bitcoin ETFs lost $95M net, the fourth day of outflows in a row, per SoSoValue data cited by Bitcoin.com.
Monday 9 Nov: $201.1M left, with BlackRock's IBIT down $213.2M, per Bitcoin.com.
November outflows total about $1.58B so far, and total assets are $92.82B, per Bitcoin.com.
US spot ether ETFs also had a fourth day of outflows, about $1.3M on 10 Nov, per Bitcoin.com.

sources.label: Bitcoin.com: fourth straight day of outflows

stories.title: MSCI decides tonight whether to drop Strategy from its indexes
stories.summary: At about 5pm ET on Wednesday (05:00 Thursday Bangkok), MSCI announces its November index changes under new rules for 'non-operating companies'. Strategy, which holds 850,364 BTC per Bitcoin.com, is a candidate for removal. Funds that copy the index would then need to sell the stock; it would stay listed on Nasdaq.
points: Results come shortly after 11:00pm CET Wed 11 Nov; changes take effect at the close on 30 Nov, per MSCI.
JPMorgan estimated about $2.8B of selling by index funds, an estimate made for an earlier version of the rules, per Bitcoin.com.
Funds tracking MSCI held about 13M Strategy shares, 3.1% of the company, per Bitcoin.com.
Strategy shares closed at $121.07 on 10 Nov, down from $145.16 on 28 Oct, per Bitcoin.com.

briefs.title: Across hit by a domain hijack
briefs.summary: Attackers took over the cross-chain protocol's web address and sent users to a phishing page; GoPlus estimates about $350K was drained and Across says victims will be made whole, per The Block.

briefs.title: OKX and ICE set a 23 Nov launch for tokenized stocks
briefs.summary: Their venture plans to open a tokenized-securities venue on 23 Nov under the SEC's innovation exemption, with 70 assets confirmed so far plus 59 ETFs, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin Core discloses three fixed bugs
briefs.summary: One is a high-severity mining bug; all were fixed in versions 30.0 and 29.2, per The Block.

briefs.title: Deutsche Bank starts crypto custody
briefs.summary: The bank now holds BTC, ETH, USDC and other tokens for European institutional clients, per The Block.

briefs.title: Prediction market loses in New York court
briefs.summary: A federal judge ruled Novig's sports event contracts are not swaps, so New York gambling law can apply, per The Block.

briefs.title: Tether supply shrinks
briefs.summary: USDT's market value fell $6.6B in 60 days, the biggest 60-day drop since 2022, per CryptoQuant data cited by CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Coinbase wins final approval for a national trust bank
briefs.summary: The OCC gave Coinbase National Trust Company final approval, moving its institutional custody under federal oversight, per Decrypt.
